title: Chapter 748 - 748 Higher-Ups; Harmony!

Chapter 748 - 748 Higher-Ups; Harmony!

Chapter 748 - 748 Higher-ups; Harmony!

748 Higher-ups; Harmony!

After obtaining the orb, Li Ke’s strength had reached a peak. No one could resist him at all.

After killing several people in a row, it produced an incomparably powerful deterrence, scaring everyone into retreating.

In the next few years, Li Ke quietly absorbed the Kylin’s blood and studied the pearl. No one dared to disturb him.

“Whoosh!”

On this day, a huge door appeared in the sky of the Ancient Mystic Realm.

This… It was the exit of the mystic realm.

The trip to the Ancient Mystic Realm ended here.

Li Ke didn’t hesitate and flew into the door.

When the people of Fire God Palace found out that Li Ke had obtained it in the Ancient Mystic Realm, they were all ecstatic.

Originally, Li Ke could only be considered average among the Holy Sons.

Now, he had directly become the number one Holy Son. He was even appointed as the Acting Palace Master by many Grand Elders and Elders. Furthermore, he was unanimously recognized as the person with the greatest hope of restoring the glory of the Fire God Palace.

The entire Fire God Palace was filled with joy.

However, if they knew that their Palace Master was cursed to death by Li Ke’s master, who knew what their expressions would be.

….

On the other hand.

Ma Zheng also walked out of the Ancient Mystic Realm.

Even though he did not receive a huge opportunity like Li Ke.

However, his gains were not bad either.

After returning to the Raincloud Altar, he went into seclusion to consolidate his strength.

Not long after, Ma Zheng was specially recruited into the Water God Palace and became an elder of the Water God Palace.

At this point…

Out of Lin Fan’s two servants, one of them had become the Fire God Palace’s Acting Palace Master while the other had become an elder of the Water God Palace. Both of them were in the upper echelons!

….

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

Time flew by.

In the blink of an eye, 20 years had passed.

“Phew!”

“Suck!”

Lin Fan used his breathing technique to absorb large amounts of pure Spirit Qi into his body and condense them.

Almost every minute and every second, his aura was growing, and his strength was constantly increasing.

That was why Lin Fan’s cultivation state had increased by another level in the past 20 years. He was now at Emperor level 6 and was only one step away from Emperor level 7.

At this moment, a clear and ethereal voice echoed throughout the entire Earth.

“Dao Friend Lin Fan, can I come out and meet you?”

Every few hundred years, a name called Lin Fan would appear on Earth.

In the beginning, the people on Earth were puzzled and puzzled.

Who was Lin Fan and where did the voice come from?

Now, when the people on Earth heard this, their bodies became solemn, and their faces were filled with piety and respect.

After 20 years of development, Little Rock, Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann had spread the name of Coiling Dragon Villa and Lin Fan across the entire world.

Right now, almost everyone on Earth treated the Coiling Dragon Villa as a holy land, and Lin Fan as the master of the world.

How could they not be pious when they suddenly heard someone calling the name of the master of the world? Disrespectful?

….

Coiling Dragon Villa.

Lin Fan opened his eyes slowly and looked up into the void.

Soon, a fair-skinned woman with a graceful figure appeared in his field of vision.

She…It was Kathleen.

When Lin Fan saw her, his black eyes sparkled.

Then, he took a step forward and disappeared from the spot.

Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others, who were also in the Coiling Dragon Villa, stopped cultivating and started discussing.

“Don’t you guys think that this time, they don’t seem to be enemies?”Su Ning said quietly.

“She has a nice voice, and she must be pretty too,” Huang Ling said.”

“Maybe we’ll have another sister soon.”Hu Tian said with a smile.

“That’s great.” Su Ning said quietly.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue nodded.

….

At this moment, in the void.

Kailin was like a fairy from a fairy tale. Her body was filled with multicolored light, and she was extremely holy.

Her beautiful eyes seemed to be surrounded by stars as she looked at the huge black hole behind her.

Then, he looked at the sapphire-like planet in front of him-Earth.

“It’s so beautiful!” he praised sincerely.

“Whoosh!”

The next moment, the void rippled slightly.

A tall and handsome figure appeared in front of them. It was Lin Fan.

Strictly speaking, this was the first time Lin Fan and Kailin had met.

When Kailin’s gaze landed on Lin Fan, her heart beat faster.

An inexplicable emotion rose in his heart.

She didn’t know if it was because she was excited to see a strong person or for some other reason.

Lin Fan smiled and said,”Welcome, Kailin!””

Hearing this, Kailin’s jade-like face blushed. She said softly,””Thank you.”

“Is this blue planet the legendary 5901?”Kathleen asked.

“According to what the outside world says, that’s true. However, I prefer to call it Earth, the land of land.”Lin Fan said.

“Earth? What a beautiful name.” Kathleen said.

“I can guarantee that the scenery inside is even more beautiful than the name! Do you want to go in and take a look?” Lin Fan said.

“That’s great.” Kathleen said with a smile.

Then, Lin Fan and Kathleen turned into a stream of light and flew towards Earth.

If it were anyone else, they would have been blocked by dozens of invisible energy cloaks before reaching Earth.

However, when Lin Fan and Kailin entered, these energy barriers melted like water ripples, allowing them to pass through.

Not long after, the blue sea, the dense forest, and the gorgeous flowers…They appeared in their sights one after another.

Kathleen couldn’t help but take a deep breath, feeling refreshed.

Originally, she felt extremely heartbroken because of Lisa, Els, and Mike’s ruthlessness.

Now, he felt like he was suddenly enlightened and very relaxed.

Lin Fan brought Kailin to play on Earth for a month. Their relationship grew rapidly and they started to interact at a negative distance.

At the same time, Kathleen fell in love with Earth even more.

On this day, Kathleen carefully tidied up her clothes and makeup.

Because Lin Fan said that he would bring her to see his wife later.

She knew what this meant.

Lin Fan smiled,” Don’t worry, they are all good people.””

“Yes, yes.” Kathleen nodded vigorously.”

Then, the two of them streaked across the sky like meteors and arrived at the Coiling Dragon Villa in the blink of an eye.

Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others quickly gathered.

“You must be Kathleen? It’s so beautiful!” Hu Tian said.

“Lin Fan only said that you’re pretty. In my opinion, you’re not pretty at all. You’re practically a fairy!”Huang Ling said.

“He’s too immortal!” Su Ningjing added,” Seeing Kailin reminds me of the Seven Fairies from Earth’s myths!”

“Kathleen, if anyone bullies you in the future, tell us. We’ll definitely help you vent your anger!”

….

The girls surrounded Kathleen and praised her. Their faces were full of smiles, and the atmosphere was extremely harmonious.
